name: Do off-market luxury homes require the same due diligence as publicly listed homes?

mainEntity.name: Do off-market luxury homes require the same due diligence as publicly listed homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely. Off-market luxury homes require the same, if not more, thorough due diligence as publicly listed properties. Buyers should still conduct professional home inspections, review all relevant disclosures, and research the property's history, title, and local zoning regulations. The discrete nature of the sale does not bypass the need for comprehensive investigation to protect your investment. Kelby Contreras ensures that regardless of how a property is found, all clients are advised to conduct rigorous due diligence to uncover any potential issues before finalizing a purchase in areas like Palm Beach or Miami Beach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, off-market luxury homes require the same rigorous due diligence, including inspections and disclosure reviews, to protect the buyer's investment.
